out.title: ITAT order largely in Maruti's favour, positive tax impact ~Rs 13,000 crore
out.summary: Maruti received an ITAT order for FY2013-14 to FY2019-20 and FY2021-22, issues majorly allowed in its favour, positive tax impact ~Rs 130,000 million; contingent liability interest reduced ~Rs 63,000 million.
